item.title: Whiteville awaiting funding clarity after FEMA lawsuit ruling
item.description: WHITEVILLE, NC (WWAY-TV) – North Carolina won a lawsuit against the Federal Emergency Management Agency this week. A federal judge has ordered FEMA to reinstate its BRIC disaster mitigation program. After FEMA canceled the program in July, it pulled back $200 million in grants that would have support 60 infrastructure projects statewide. item.title: Angel Tree program brings Christmas joy to Easterseals Port Health clients
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — This Christmas tree holds ornaments, is strung with lights, and white notes with wish lists attached. It’s an angel tree and has become a symbol of the season for Easterseals Port Health. Each card holds a specific name and the Christmas lists from Easterseals clients and their families.
